~=J(?D|rUjD04[z.P}?V.text:
Hello there! If you would like to add a music. Upload your music and use the "Add music" block. Be sure that the song name has to be the same, or else it won't work. If you're not sure the music is playing, then test to play the music, or copy and paste the music's name to the custom block. If a music come to a Mario Party Series, then use the audio exemption for Scratchers who don't want to hear party game audio like @SmashBrosFans2020. Same with the "accelerando music", and "unsuitable music themes".

I recommend you not to add over 80 music tracks from the refusal-to-save error, or the question mark boxes. I'm fine with 60 music tracks, but it's best to avoid the music length being 80. It's also recommended to refrain 3-minute long songs (180 secs), or too many accelerando songs.
